records.query: Amazon 近一年的營收成長率是多少？加上新聞中避險基金在 SpaceX IPO 前拋售包括 Amazon 在內的大型科技股，這對市場如何看待 Amazon 透露了什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 在 2025 年的合併營收較 2024 年成長 **12%**（從 6,379.59 億美元（$637,959 million） 增至 7,169.24 億美元（$716,924 million））【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #0】；同時在 2025 年的年度報告中亦指出合併營收增長 12%（不含匯率影響）【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #211】。

在 SpaceX IPO 前，對沖基金拋售包括 Amazon 在內的「Magnificent Seven」大型科技股，並有部份基金佈建空頭部位，顯示投資人正於 IPO 前「清倉」或降低對整體科技板塊的曝險【NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。因此，市場對 Amazon 的短期情緒偏向謹慎或看跌，將其視為與其他大型科技股同樣受資金流出影響的標的，而非僅因基本面表現而受到正面評價。這種拋售行為透露出投資人對即將到來的 SpaceX 上市可能帶來的市場波動持保守態度，並在短期內對 Amazon 等科技巨頭的股價形成壓力。

By Nell Mackenzie
LONDON, June 12 (Reuters) - Hedge funds sold out of the biggest U.S. tech stocks, and some even added ‌bearish positions, according to data from a JPMorgan note late ‌Thursday, just before SpaceX was set to go public on Friday. Shares in the "Magnificent Seven" -- ​a group that includes some of the biggest tech names on Wall Street, namely
Nvidia
,
Apple
, Amazon.com, Alphabet, Meta,
Tesla
, and Microsoft, have all declined since last Friday. The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF, which tracks these ‌stocks closely, declined over 2.4% ⁠since June 5, with some analysts saying investors were clearing their decks in order to prepare for the ⁠debut of Elon Musk's Space X on Friday. SpaceX posted a net loss of $4.94 billion in 2025, but its landmark listing targets a valuation of $1.77 ​trillion ​in a record-setting IPO, which would ​make it the seventh-biggest publicly ‌traded U.S. company by market value.
